g.text: DTap (secondary): effect of adding the user task
Positive = task lowers error; negative = task raises error. Lines: saved pointwise 95% group-bootstrap intervals.
62 shared complete groups of 66 planned; 64/66 planned groups are legal-domain cases. Descriptive, not pooled with main results.
Missing-outcome bounds use a different, all-planned cohort; see source tables. No new statistical fitting.
